#include <iostream>

struct Pair {
    long long first, second;
    static Pair makePair(long long f, long long s) { return {f, s}; }
};

class Graph {
public:
    static const int REMOVED_BIT = 0;
    int vertexCount;
    int edgeCount;
    std::vector<int> firstOutbound;
    std::vector<int> firstInbound;
    struct Edge {
        int id;
    };
    std::vector<Edge> edges;
    std::vector<int> nextInbound;
    std::vector<int> nextOutbound;
    std::vector<int> from;
    std::vector<int> to;
    std::vector<long long> weight;
    std::vector<long long> capacity;
    std::vector<int> reverseEdge;
    std::vector<int> flags;

    Graph(int vertexCount) : vertexCount(vertexCount) {
        firstOutbound.assign(vertexCount, -1);
        firstInbound.assign(vertexCount, -1);
        from.reserve(vertexCount);
        to.reserve(vertexCount);
        nextOutbound.reserve(vertexCount);
        nextInbound.reserve(vertexCount);
        weight.reserve(vertexCount);
        capacity.reserve(vertexCount);
        reverseEdge.reserve(vertexCount);
        flags.reserve(vertexCount);
        edges.reserve(vertexCount);
        edgeCount = 0;
    }

    int addEdge(int fromID, int toID, long long w, long long cap, int reverseE) {
        ensureEdgeCapacity(edgeCount + 1);
        int idx = edgeCount;
        if (firstOutbound[fromID] != -1) {
            nextOutbound[idx] = firstOutbound[fromID];
        } else {
            nextOutbound[idx] = -1;
        }
        firstOutbound[fromID] = idx;

        if (!firstInbound.empty()) {
            if (firstInbound[toID] != -1) {
                nextInbound[idx] = firstInbound[toID];
            } else {
                nextInbound[idx] = -1;
            }
            firstInbound[toID] = idx;
        }

        from.push_back(fromID);
        to.push_back(toID);
        if (cap != 0) {
            if (capacity.size() <= idx) capacity.resize(idx + 1);
            capacity[idx] = cap;
        }
        if (w != 0) {
            if (weight.size() <= idx) weight.resize(idx + 1);
            weight[idx] = w;
        }
        if (reverseE != -1) {
            if (reverseEdge.size() <= idx) reverseEdge.resize(idx + 1);
            reverseEdge[idx] = reverseE;
        }
        if (edges.size() <= idx) edges.resize(idx + 1);
        edges[idx] = {idx};
        edgeCount++;
        return idx;
    }

    int addFlowWeightedEdge(int from, int to, long long w, long long cap) {
        if (cap == 0) return addEdge(from, to, w, 0, -1);
        int lastEdgeIndex = edgeCount;
        addEdge(to, from, -w, 0, lastEdgeIndex + 1);
        return addEdge(from, to, w, cap, lastEdgeIndex);
    }

    int vertexCountFunc() const { return vertexCount; }

    int firstOutboundFunc(int v) const {
        int id = firstOutbound[v];
        while (id != -1 && isRemoved(id)) {
            id = nextOutbound[id];
        }
        return id;
    }

    int nextOutboundFunc(int id) const {
        id = nextOutbound[id];
        while (id != -1 && isRemoved(id)) {
            id = nextOutbound[id];
        }
        return id;
    }

    int source(int id) const { return from[id]; }
    int destination(int id) const { return to[id]; }
    long long getWeight(int id) const {
        return weight.size() > id ? weight[id] : 0;
    }
    long long getCapacity(int id) const {
        return capacity.size() > id ? capacity[id] : 0;
    }
    long long flow(int id) const {
        if (reverseEdge.size() <= id || capacity.size() <= reverseEdge[id]) return 0;
        return capacity[reverseEdge[id]];
    }
    void pushFlow(int id, long long flowVal) {
        if (flowVal == 0) return;
        if (flowVal > 0) {
            if (getCapacity(id) < flowVal) throw std::invalid_argument("Not enough capacity");
        } else {
            if (getFlow(id) < -flowVal) throw std::invalid_argument("Not enough capacity");
        }
        capacity[id] -= flowVal;
        capacity[reverseEdge[id]] += flowVal;
    }
    bool flag(int id, int bit) const { return ((flags[id] >> bit) & 1) != 0; }
    bool isRemoved(int id) const { return flag(id, REMOVED_BIT); }

private:
    void ensureEdgeCapacity(int size) {
        if (from.size() < size) {
            size_t oldSize = from.size();
            from.resize(size);
            to.resize(size);
            nextOutbound.resize(size);
            nextInbound.resize(size);
            weight.resize(size);
            capacity.resize(size);
            reverseEdge.resize(size);
            flags.resize(size);
            edges.resize(size);
        }
    }
};

class MinCostFlow {
public:
    MinCostFlow(Graph& g, int s, int t, bool hasNeg) : graph(g), source(s), destination(t) {
        vertexCount = g.vertexCountFunc();
        phi.assign(vertexCount, LLONG_MAX);
        if (hasNeg) {
            fordBellman();
        }
        dijkstraResult.assign(vertexCount, LLONG_MAX);
        lastEdge.assign(vertexCount, -1);
        if (g.isSparse()) {
            // Use a custom heap if needed; here using a priority_queue with pair.
            // Will implement custom comparator accordingly.
            heapAvailable = true;
            // For simplicity, just use priority_queue
        } else {
            visited.assign(vertexCount, 0);
        }
        visitIndex = 0;
    }

private:
    Graph& graph;
    int source;
    int destination;
    int vertexCount;
    std::vector<long long> phi;
    std::vector<long long> dijkstraResult;
    std::vector<int> lastEdge;
    bool heapAvailable = false;
    std::priority_queue<std::pair<long long, int>, std::vector<std::pair<long long, int>>, std::greater<std::pair<long long, int>>> heapPQ;
    std::vector<int> visited;
    int visitIndex;

    void fordBellman() {
        std::fill(phi.begin(), phi.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        phi[source] = 0;
        std::vector<bool> inQueue(vertexCount, false);
        std::vector<int> queue(vertexCount + 1);
        int head = 0, tail = 0, maxSteps = 2 * vertexCount * vertexCount;
        queue[tail++] = source;
        inQueue[source] = true;
        int stepCount = 0;
        while (head != tail) {
            int v = queue[head++];
            if (head == queue.size()) head = 0;
            inQueue[v] = false;
            int edgeID = graph.firstOutboundFunc(v);
            while (edgeID != -1) {
                long long total = phi[v] + graph.getWeight(edgeID);
                int dest = graph.destination(edgeID);
                if (graph.getCapacity(edgeID) != 0 && phi[dest] > total) {
                    phi[dest] = total;
                    if (!inQueue[dest]) {
                        queue[tail++] = dest;
                        if (tail == queue.size()) tail = 0;
                        inQueue[dest] = true;
                    }
                }
                edgeID = graph.nextOutboundFunc(edgeID);
            }
            if (++stepCount > maxSteps) throw std::runtime_error("Graph contains negative cycle");
        }
    }

public:
    std::pair<long long, long long> minCostMaxFlow() { return minCostMaxFlow(LLONG_MAX); }

    std::pair<long long, long long> minCostMaxFlow(long long maxFlow) {
        long long cost = 0, flow = 0;
        while (maxFlow != 0) {
            if (graph.isSparse()) {
                dijkstraAlgorithm();
            } else {
                dijkstraAlgorithmFull();
            }
            if (lastEdge[destination] == -1) {
                return {cost, flow};
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < vertexCount; ++i) {
                if (dijkstraResult[i] != LLONG_MAX) {
                    phi[i] += dijkstraResult[i];
                }
            }
            int v = destination;
            long long currentFlow = maxFlow;
            long long currentCost = 0;
            while (v != source) {
                int ed = lastEdge[v];
                if (ed == -1) break;
                currentFlow = std::min(currentFlow, graph.getCapacity(ed));
                currentCost += graph.getWeight(ed);
                v = graph.source(ed);
            }
            maxFlow -= currentFlow;
            cost += currentCost * currentFlow;
            flow += currentFlow;
            v = destination;
            while (v != source) {
                int ed = lastEdge[v];
                graph.pushFlow(ed, currentFlow);
                v = graph.source(ed);
            }
        }
        return {cost, flow};
    }

private:
    void dijkstraAlgorithm() {
        std::fill(dijkstraResult.begin(), dijkstraResult.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        std::fill(lastEdge.begin(), lastEdge.end(), -1);
        dijkstraResult[source] = 0;
        // Using STL priority_queue as heap
        while (!heapPQ.empty()) heapPQ.pop();
        heapPQ.emplace(0, source);
        while (!heapPQ.empty()) {
            auto [dist, cur] = heapPQ.top(); heapPQ.pop();
            if (dist > dijkstraResult[cur]) continue;
            int edgeID = graph.firstOutboundFunc(cur);
            while (edgeID != -1) {
                if (graph.getCapacity(edgeID) != 0) {
                    int nextV = graph.destination(edgeID);
                    long long total = graph.getWeight(edgeID) - phi[nextV] + phi[cur] + dijkstraResult[cur];
                    if (dijkstraResult[nextV] > total) {
                        dijkstraResult[nextV] = total;
                        lastEdge[nextV] = edgeID;
                        heapPQ.emplace(dijkstraResult[nextV], nextV);
                    }
                }
                edgeID = graph.nextOutboundFunc(edgeID);
            }
        }
    }

    void dijkstraAlgorithmFull() {
        ++visitIndex;
        std::fill(dijkstraResult.begin(), dijkstraResult.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        std::fill(lastEdge.begin(), lastEdge.end(), -1);
        dijkstraResult[source] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < vertexCount; ++i) {
            int minIdx = -1;
            long long minDist = LLONG_MAX;
            for (int j = 0; j < vertexCount; ++j) {
                if (visited[j] != visitIndex && dijkstraResult[j] < minDist) {
                    minDist = dijkstraResult[j];
                    minIdx = j;
                }
            }
            if (minIdx == -1) return;
            visited[minIdx] = visitIndex;
            int edgeID = graph.firstOutboundFunc(minIdx);
            while (edgeID != -1) {
                if (graph.getCapacity(edgeID) != 0) {
                    int nextV = graph.destination(edgeID);
                    if (visited[nextV] != visitIndex) {
                        long long total = graph.getWeight(edgeID) - phi[nextV] + phi[minIdx] + minDist;
                        if (dijkstraResult[nextV] > total) {
                            dijkstraResult[nextV] = total;
                            lastEdge[nextV] = edgeID;
                        }
                    }
                }
                edgeID = graph.nextOutboundFunc(edgeID);
            }
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;
    std::vector<int> a(n);
    std::vector<int> cnt(26, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> a[i];
        cnt[s[i] - 'a']++;
    }
    int totalVertices = n + 100;
    Graph g(totalVertices);
    int source = totalVertices - 2;
    int target = totalVertices - 1;
    for (int i = 0; i * 2 < n; ++i) g.addFlowWeightedEdge(i, target, 0, 2);
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; ++i) {
        g.addFlowWeightedEdge(source, n + i, 0, cnt[i]);
        for (int j = 0; j * 2 < n; ++j) {
            long long w = 0;
            if (s[j] == s[n - j - 1]) {
                if (s[j] - 'a' == i) w = -std::max(a[j], a[n - j - 1]);
                g.addFlowWeightedEdge(n + i, j, w, 1);
            } else {
                if (s[j] - 'a' == i) w -= a[j];
                if (s[n - j - 1] - 'a' == i) w -= a[n - j - 1];
                g.addFlowWeightedEdge(n + i, j, w, 1);
            }
        }
    }
    MinCostFlow mcmf(g, source, target, true);
    auto [costRes, flowRes] = mcmf.minCostMaxFlow();
    std::cout << -costRes << "\n";

    return 0;
}
